nodes.label: MOS 6502 CPU
nodes.rationale: Cycle-correct at instruction granularity; cheap on this host and the difference between 'mostly works' and 'loads tapes'.

nodes.label: INS8255 PPI at #B000
nodes.rationale: The whole of the Atom's I/O; port C output latches kept separate from inputs or MOS read-modify-write corrupts mode bits; BSR path required.

nodes.label: 6522 VIA at #B800
nodes.rationale: Fitted by default because the MOS reads #B80C (PCR) on every character and spins on open bus without it.

nodes.label: 8271 FDC at #0A00
nodes.rationale: Sub-page device inside RAM page #0A; page marked PAGE_IO so the fast path does not skip it.

nodes.label: Alpha/SG6 VRAM byte wiring (bit 6 A/S+INT/EXT, bit 7 INV)
nodes.rationale: Settled by executing the MOS; an earlier version had bits swapped and rendered the cursor as an empty graphics cell.

nodes.label: Port A VDG mode bits (A/G bit 4, GM0-2 bits 5-7)
RP2350 / Pico 2 target
nodes.rationale: Fits in 520 KiB SRAM without PSRAM so one image runs on Pico 2, Pico 2 W and Plus 2 W.

nodes.label: clk_sys 150 MHz stock clock
nodes.rationale: One of two points where SPI divider gives full 75 MHz; 200 MHz would slow the display 1.5x.

nodes.label: core/ vs port/ layering
nodes.rationale: core/ is pure C with no SDK so it is host-testable against Dormann's suite before hardware exists.

nodes.label: atom_run seam with cycle-debt carry
nodes.rationale: Executes whole instructions until at least N cycles and returns the true count; debt carried keeps long-run timing from drifting.

nodes.label: Three-buffer snapshot pool (free/filling/ready/rendering)
nodes.rationale: Core 1 worst case ~17-18 ms exceeds a 16.7 ms field; a third buffer avoids blocking core 0 or racing a ready buffer.

nodes.label: I/O decode by mask (partial decoding, mirrors)
RAM population config (upper RAM #4000-#7FFF)
nodes.rationale: Added at M8: Chuckie Egg's loader needs 32 KiB; without it the game fell into BASIC as ERROR 5.

nodes.label: Open bus as last value on bus
Switch-dispatched 6502 interpreter
nodes.rationale: Dense switch compiles to a table branch on Cortex-M33 with no call overhead, keeps CPU state in registers.

nodes.label: CPU budget measured at M7 (158-218 host cycles/insn, 2.2-2.9x headroom)
Hot code SRAM tiers (tier 2 ships)
nodes.rationale: Tier 2 gives 1.12-1.19x for 25 KiB; tier 3 bought nothing.

nodes.label: core 1 sleep_us alarm IRQ interrupting core 0
nodes.rationale: Replacing sleep_us(20) with busy_wait_us_32 was worth 1.11x and cut run-to-run spread.

nodes.label: No decoded framebuffer; band generator
nodes.rationale: VRAM is the source of truth; no second copy of the screen to keep in sync; mode change is a LUT rebuild.

nodes.label: Dirty-band presenter (24 bands of 8 rows)
nodes.rationale: Mode byte is part of the shadow because a mode/CSS change repaints everything while VRAM is byte-identical; over-mark rather than under-mark.

nodes.label: SPI wire is the bottleneck, not the 6502
Box-filter integrator of PC2 at rational sample period
nodes.rationale: Integrate, do not sample: removes aliasing of 1-bit signal, cost per toggle not per sample, exact for square waves.

nodes.label: PWM audio with chained ping-pong DMA ring
Pacing on the audio ring (throttling)
nodes.rationale: PWM wrap is the most stable timebase; pacing on it holds the queue without a wall-clock timer.

nodes.label: Core 0 log ring drained by core 1
nodes.rationale: A blocking heartbeat costs ~30 ms vs ~11 ms queue slack.

nodes.label: Alt layer for missing Atom keys
Game keymaps (overlay layouts, .map files)
nodes.rationale: Games scan the matrix directly; an overlay keeps standard bindings for typing; built-ins name no game.

nodes.label: Keyboard matrix settled by executing kernel scan at #FE71
Tape phase 1: OSLOAD/OSSAVE trap at #F96E/#FAE5
nodes.rationale: Trap on handlers not #FFxx entries so repointed vectors are never trapped; leaves ROM's page-zero state byte for byte.

nodes.label: CPU stall like RDY low during tape call
Tape phase 2: UEF at signal level
Cassette brought up to date on port C read
nodes.rationale: Nothing clocked per instruction; costs 3.5% on scrolling.

nodes.label: LOAD "" is nameless format, not next file
Snapshot format (psnap, CRC, ROM hash, two-pass load)
nodes.rationale: No ROM bytes, only hashes; two-pass load so a bad file changes nothing.

nodes.label: Flyback-split field loop (atom_run_field)
nodes.rationale: Guest instructions must run while FS is low or the flag is unobservable.

hyperedges.label: Signal-level tape pipeline (gzip -> UEF -> cassette -> port C)
Video presentation path (snapshot -> diff -> LUT -> DMA)
Audio path (PC2 integrator -> PCM queue -> PWM DMA, paced)
